status: planned; no HyperDRC runtime changes in the native-metric API batch
carrier: PcbRegion retains CurveRegion2. Polygon report rings never become authoritative input when exact area, bounds, components, or metrics are unavailable.
source_geometry: Via center and size tokens enter SourceScalar/Real directly, with a fallible two-semicircle native construction. Broader pad, track, slot, custom geometry and other formats remain separately tracked.
metric_consumers: PreparedBoundaryDistance and point/boundary threshold helpers use authoritative native segments, including hole boundaries, and Segment2 distance queries. Component extraction and regularization must describe the filled-region boundary. Empty geometry is distinct from a failed measurement.
broad_phase: Only certified conservative native bounds can reject a candidate. Finite indices use outward enclosures; an unavailable enclosure disables that rejection. Projected rings and nearest-rounded bounds are not rejection proofs.
uncertainty: Retain failure from every relevant candidate and comparison. Convert failures into geometry-uncertainty findings attributed to the requested check, preserving readiness blocking behavior. Audit all callers that currently continue or is_some_and after a missing metric.
caches: Area, bounds and component extraction cache completed certified values only. A denied operation cannot poison a later retry, and a source-construction error cannot publish the placeholder empty region area as valid.
projection: Projection and component-extraction failures remain typed, and report profiles cannot fall back to Polygon::new over display chords. Legacy projection API migration must be explicit and cannot silently drop a failed component.
regressions: Retained source-circle public loader fixture must pass for both F.Cu and B.Cu.
Exact decimal source centers and dimensions beyond binary64 resolution remain distinct.
Circle/line and circle/circle clearance cases between sampled chords and the authored boundary match independent analytic oracles.
Different report resolutions preserve area, bounds, distance and readiness decisions.
Unavailable geometry and exhausted queries block affected readiness checks; a subsequent admitted retry succeeds.
Existing exact line and hole metrics retain their answers.
validation: Focused geometry/import/readiness tests first, then the configured HyperDRC release suite, strict all-target Clippy and docs. Preserve behavior changes justified by authored geometry; do not rewrite expected values merely to make tests pass. Compare performance on cases whose exact geometry and answers match, and label newly supported native-circle measurements separately.
